subject.title: Windows QuickStart defaults first chat to paid Anthropic model without credit warning

question: What first-run policy should QuickStart use when Anthropic auth selects an Opus-tier model that may require paid API credits?
rationale: The code fix is bounded, but choosing between warning, default-model change, provider usage preflight, or documented intentional behavior changes onboarding policy and possibly existing user expectations.

options.title: Warn Before Hatch
options.body: Keep the selected Anthropic provider/model but show a clear paid-credit risk warning and easy model/provider switch before sending the bootstrap chat.

options.title: Change QuickStart Default
options.body: Move Anthropic QuickStart toward a cheaper/default beta or CLI-backed model path so fresh users are less likely to hit paid API-credit failures.

options.title: Keep Opus Intentional
options.body: Leave the Opus default in place and limit the fix to clearer docs/status/error copy, accepting that users without credits may fail on first chat.

recommendation.title: Warn Before Hatch
recommendation.body: Keep the selected Anthropic provider/model but show a clear paid-credit risk warning and easy model/provider switch before sending the bootstrap chat.

likelyOwner.reason: This owner has the strongest history on Anthropic default policy, setup wizard surfaces, and recent provider billing visibility work.
